giga_tech_aeternite_armor.d: The Aeternites employ an unorthodox combination of shields and armor fused into a single component, powered by highly advanced controlled Loop-Quantum phenomena.

giga_tech_aeternite_planetcraft.d: Thanks to a detailed analysis of Aeternite technologies and their planetcraft designs, we might be able to restore Aeternite Planetcrafts in order to use them in our own armed forces.

giga_tech_blokkat_afterburner.d: In addition to their esoteric FTL thrusters, Blokkat vessels employ these thrusters which push against the very fabric of our universe in order to boost the speed of their crafts even further.

giga_tech_blokkat_armor.d: These extremely tough armor platings are made up of tightly-packed Planck length-sized particles. They form complex subatomic neural structures allowing the material to autonomously react to changes and adapt accordingly near-instantaneously.

giga_tech_blokkat_armor_study.d: Studying the Blokkats' engineering methods and material science is an important step in understanding how their ships and technologies function.

giga_tech_blokkat_blokkwork_power_node.d: With our newfound understanding of Blokkat technology granted by the Blokkilian Equations, we are now ready to truly prepare our ascension by establishing the necessary infrastructure to connect ourselves to the Blokkwork. Although these power nodes will not let us access the full extent of the Blokkwork for now (as it is not yet completely established over our galaxy), they will nonetheless let us greatly streamline our planetary operations by generating our own Blokkwork across our empire.

giga_tech_blokkat_booster.d: Reactor boosters drawing additional energy from a higher-dimensional source. They also serve to improve the efficiency of the vessel as a whole.

giga_tech_blokkat_computer.d: The application of Blokkat technologies to the artificial intelligence of our vessels will enable us to create truly terrifying vessels of war.

giga_tech_blokkat_dimension_study.d: Studying the Blokkats' hyperdimensional engineering methods is an important step towards complete understanding of these extragalactic invaders.

giga_tech_blokkat_emitter.d: The Pentafocused emitter is a titanic piercing weapon of Blokkat design, which is capable of "leaping" through a higher dimension in order to bypass the shielding and armor of energy vessels.

giga_tech_blokkat_energy_transfer.d: The Blokkats have long since converted their technologies to be based on the most fundamental aspect of the universe: energy. They utilize the Blokkwork to transfer vast quantities of energy across great distances and subsequently shape this energy into whatever they may require. Understanding how to base an entire civilization on the universe's most basic resource is paramount to solving the Blokkilian Equations.

giga_tech_blokkat_fix_systems.d: A colossal megastructure capable into the future to retrieve a star from another era of the universe might be what we need in order to undo the damage caused by the perfidious Blokkats.

giga_tech_blokkat_ftl.d: There is no effective difference between a Blokkat thruster and a Blokkat FTL drive. They both employ a sort of device anchored through a higher dimension which quite literally "drags" the space surrounding the ship and moves it around with instantaneous acceleration.

giga_tech_blokkat_gigarelay_core.d: The Pylon's Power Core shall provide a direct link to the Blokkwork itself and enable the flow of near endless energy from the Blokkwork to our Blokkwork Power Node network.

giga_tech_blokkat_gigarelay_frame.d: The Pylon's frame is to be an intricate 6-dimensional construct embedded into the fabric of reality itself. Such a degree of sophistication is required if we are to bring the Blokkwork's full power into our galaxy.

giga_tech_blokkat_history.d: The analysis of the Blokkats' complex path intertwined with that of the Paluush will help us understand their mindset and technological evolution better.

giga_tech_blokkat_hullrepair.d: Swarms of miniscule robots that serve as relays for the neural networks contained within Blokkat armors, increasing their efficiency and enabling them to repair faster. Blokkat models also transmit data to and from the Blokkwork for increased synchronization.

giga_tech_blokkat_intergalactic_logistic.d: How to properly coordinate harvesting operations spread over a significant portion of the observable universe involving the mass-energy of several galaxies being shipped across intergalactic distances? When one is running an operation as large as that of the Blokkats, inefficiency is simply unacceptable and logistics must thus be refined to perfection.

giga_tech_blokkat_laser.d: The Planck-Dismantlement Beam is a Blokkat device based on their stripmining apparatuses. Not only do these devices systematically dismantle the very fabric of enemy ships down to the subplanck level, reducing them to a slurry of hypercondensed quantum foam, they also collect said foam and store it aboard Blokkat vessels, where it can later be reprocessed into usable materials.

giga_tech_blokkat_mega_stage_0.d: The Hyperdimensional Stabilizer shall be one of the largest megastructures ever conceived, built for the sole purpose of bringing down the Blokkat-Vester's shield. Designing an appropriate construction site is a crucial step in the assembly of this colossal construct.

giga_tech_blokkat_mega_stage_1.d: A special black hole employing methods very much like that of the Blokkats could be used to power the mighty Hyperdimensional Destabilizer and effectively enable it to strike at the Blokkats' seemingly unbreakable shield.

giga_tech_blokkat_mega_stage_2.d: By "skewing" the higher dimensions employed by the Blokkat Hyperdimensional Bulwark, we can forcefully bring it down one dimension, thus bringing it within the reach of our Pentadimensional Singularity.

giga_tech_blokkat_mega_stage_3.d: Manipulating the sheer flow of energy required to bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark will require an untold number of higher-dimensional structures coupled with femtosecond-precision when it comes to executing the full sequence.

giga_tech_blokkat_mega_stage_4.d: The ability to strike at a target from both the past, the future and higher dimensions will ensure we can bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark down with much greater ease than before. Additionally, the wider application of this technology to our weapons systems will noticeably increase their potential damage output.

giga_tech_blokkat_missile.d: These advanced launchers catapult a seeking four-dimensional singularity towards enemy ships. While they appear detached from Blokkat ships, these singularities are actually more akin to "lassos", as they are connected to Blokkat vessels through a higher dimension and are later "reeled back" by said vessels through this higher dimension after plowing through enemy ships. This enables the Blokkats to collect whatever the singularities destroyed and process it for later usage.

giga_tech_blokkat_obliterator.d: The Evictor Ray is the largest Blokkat weapon encountered so far. This beam of untold power tears reality asunder and forcefully compresses its target into a 0-dimensional object by focusing the energies of several higher dimensions onto a localized area of the spacetime continuum, destroying it instantly.

giga_tech_blokkat_pd.d: These hyperefficient point-defence systems shatter the very fabric of reality around enemy projectiles, obliterating them before they even get close to Blokkat vessels.

giga_tech_blokkat_plasma.d: The Absolute Scorch Blaster fires a glob of plasma heated to the Planck Temperature, which is practically the highest possible temperature under known models of physics. The plasma is kept to these extreme temperatures by a constant influx of energy through a higher dimension and matter which comes in contact with the plasma is "absorbed" into said dimension, converted into energy in a way similar to how Blokkats harvest star systems and then fueled back into the plasma to further sustain the projectile's heat.

giga_tech_blokkat_reactor.d: Blokkat ships are powered by these mysterious constructs that draw untold amounts of energy transferred from a higher dimension.

giga_tech_blokkat_reprogram.d: By delicately altering the mind of a Blokkat using egregiously delicate and expensive methods, we might just be able to "switch" their allegiance from their original civilization to ours.

giga_tech_blokkat_scrap_uses.d: Studying the Blokkat Scrap recovered from destroyed Blokkat vessels is surely going to be a great boon to our Blokkat research.

giga_tech_blokkat_sensors.d: These Blokkat-designed sensors look for the oscillations that 3-dimensional matter creates within the higher-dimensional manifold of the universe.

giga_tech_blokkat_shield.d: Much like the Blokkat-Vester's humongous shield, these smaller protective barriers rotate within a higher dimension, meaning only an infinitely small chunk of the full shield is ever exposed to enemy fire at once. If it is damaged, the damaged area is instantly shifted back into hyperdimensional space to be regenerated.

giga_tech_blokkat_snare.d: By severing individual Blokkats' connection to the Blokkwork and neutralizing them, we might be able to ultimately contain them provided we possess the necessary infrastructure to deny their escape. This will require the construction of a specialized holding cell surrounding the Blokkat within hyperdimensional space.

giga_tech_blokkat_sociology_study.d: Studying how Blokkat civilisation functions will be a critical step in learning how to best counter their terrifyingly advanced technologies.

giga_tech_blokkat_strikecraft.d: These spaceborne units heavily resemble actual Blokkats themselves and are geared for spaceship combat. They are most often remotely controlled by Blokkats within the mothership and are even sometimes Blokkats.

giga_tech_blokkat_subplanck_engineering.d: It is a known fact that the Blokkats no longer rely on baryonic matter to function, instead utilizing raw energy to create new types of elementary particles better fit for their operations. These particles can thus be extremely small and allow for their devices to be much, much denser than ones built using conventional particles. If we are to understand how they achieved such a feat, we must study how the Blokkats utilize the Blokkwork to spontaneously generate particles capable of projecting their will down to the Planck scale.

giga_tech_blokkat_timetravel.d: The understanding and subsequent application of Blokkat femtosecond timetravel methods to effectively have a single item simultaneously undertake several operations in both the past and future is likely to be a great boon to both our own industry and Blokkat-related research.

giga_tech_translate_blokkatese.d: Blokkat language revolves on an incredibly complex set of energy waves entangled within higher dimensions, transmitted across intergalactic distances through the Blokkwork. Managing to truly understand this language would surely let us establish closer relations with these beings.

giga_tech_blokkat_engineering_repeatable.d: Studying how the Blokkats engineer their ships and materials is a difficult task to undertake remotely, but will provide valuable intel on their vessels and will likely help our science teams in designing new and innovating materials.

giga_tech_blokkat_physics_repeatable.d: The Blokkat's hyperdimensional engineering methods are far more advanced than what we are currently capable of undertaking. If we were to study and understand them, the applications would be limitless.

giga_tech_blokkat_scrap_damage.d: A slower and more careful approach to our utilization of Blokkat Scrap in our own vessels will yield more permanent results. The scrap can most notably be used to figure out ways to assault Blokkat vessels and structures from multiple dimensions at once.

giga_tech_blokkat_scrap_research.d: A slower and more careful approach to our analysis of Blokkat Scrap will yield more permanent results.

giga_tech_blokkat_society_repeatable.d: The Blokkwork is a massive information and energy network hosted within a higher dimension which connects all Blokkats together. Decrypting and studying it would yield invaluable Blokkat-related data. Perhaps we can even apply the Blokkwork's methods to our own empire, as well.

tech_qnm_utilities.d: The Compound is a threat to all life in the galaxy, and possibly even beyond. Our tests have shown that negative mass is the only thing we know of that can harm them. From this lead, we have begun to develop energy weapons that employ negative mass so that we can finally fight back.

tech_qnm_disruptors.d: The Negative Mass Disruptor fires waves of tremendously destructive negative mass which decohere large swathes of matter. Unfortunately, these waves dissipate after a short distance.

tech_qnm_lasers.d: The Negative Mass Laser employs a focused negative mass conduit to decohere any form of matter, baryonic or otherwise.

tech_qnm_pd_tracking.d: The Negative Mass Point Defense fires an expanding wave of negative mass towards incoming projectiles, throwing them off-course.

tech_qnm_plasma.d: The Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher fires coherent spheres of negative mass that explosively disrupt any form of matter they strike.

tech_sm_autocannons.d: The Sentient Metal Ripper shoots numerous tiny sentient metal spikes, each programmed to assimilate any form of matter they come into contact with, then condensing into a sphere and disconnecting from its point of contact.

tech_sm_flak_batteries.d: The Sentient Metal Flak Battery utilizes the material's local network intelligence to aim more precisely and accurately at incoming projectiles than we were ever able before.

tech_sm_kinetic_artillery.d: The Sentient Metal Artillery amalgamates and then fires a large spike of Sentient Metal programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Fighters and small ships are immediately assimilated; larger ships sustain heavy damage as sentient metal rips chunks out of their hull.

tech_sm_mass_drivers.d: The Sentient Metal Railgun amalgamates and then fires a small sentient metal spike programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Once the projectile reaches a certain threshold of absorbed material, it condenses into a sphere and decouples.

tech_qnm_energy_torpedoes.d: Negative Mass Torpedoes use the repulsive force of negative mass to amplify the destructive power of our packed neutron warheads.

tech_qnm_arc_emitter.d: The Negative Mass Emitter fires a scatter-shot of randomly polarized and spun negative mass rays, to which dedicated defenses are nothing but more hull.

tech_qnm_energy_lance.d: The Negative Mass Lance fires a continuous ray of negative mass, tearing apart even the most reinforced material defenses at the subatomic (or equivalent) level.

tech_sm_mass_accelerator.d: The Sentient Metal Absorber launches enormous Sentient Metal spikes, often large enough to fully assimilate smaller ships in a single shot.

tech_qnm_titanic.d: The Negative Mass Beam is a titanic focused ray that decoheres vast swathes of matter in a single hit.

tech_sm_titanic.d: The Sentient Metal Devourer doesn't directly utilize sentient metal to damage its targets. Rather, it uses the material's connection to the Everchanging, along with the Enigmatic Pattern, to have the Everchanging open a power transfer micro wormhole. It directs the resultant colossal outpouring of energy towards enemy vessels.

tech_katzen_atomic_munitions.d: The extremely militaristic and nuclear-loving Katzens have managed to destroy the surfaces of both Katzenland and Flusion with remarkable ease and efficiency. They seemed to employ a vast array of different explosives in order to deal as much damage as possible, ranging from radioactive fission warheads, to antimatter bombs, and biochemical weaponry. By adopting their methods, our ships could be made to completely devastate enemy worlds with ease.

giga_tech_katzen_panzers.d: Based on blueprints retrieved from the heart of the Katzenartig Imperium itself, these mighty machines capable of spewing nuclear fire anytime and anywhere are sure to turn any combat to our favor.

giga_tech_kaiser_moon.d: The study of the Kaiser Moon has allowed us to recreate the superweapon's blueprints. With much heavier armaments than a regular Attack Moon, the Kaiser Moon is a fearsome superweapon that would undoubtedly dominate the stellar battlefield.

giga_tech_stellarite_kaiser_moon.d: The study of the Stellarite Kaiser Moon has yielded some insight on what it is made out of. It seems to be built from a material containing ridiculous energies, which allowed the Stellarite Kaiser Moon to boast exceedingly powerful weapons. We are still uncertain as to how or why the Kaiser was able to acquire the necessary resources to build one, though.

giga_tech_repeatable_increased_katzen_da.d: By further studying Katzen ship engineering, we can locate weakpoints within their designs, which can then be exploited to facilitate their destruction. Enigmatic Engineering will completely nullify any risks of the Kaiser finding out about our plans.

giga_tech_eawaf_psifusion.d: Replicating the esoteric workings of Helios' infernal core within a controlled environment and on an industrial scale enables tremendous energy production and the facilitated production of heavy elements.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_secret.d: Studying how the Sirens unleash their enthralling spell could have great application for our government and society.

giga_tech_thaumaturgic_weaponry.d: Faust's inhabitants have devised rifles and weapons infused with powerful crystals which far surpass conventional weaponry. While it might have appeared to be magic to them, which drastically limited just how much they could propagate the technology, a thorough study into the nature of these crystals might just enable us to standardize their usage within our armed forces. This would however entail a significant Rare Crystal upkeep cost.

giga_tech_eawaf_disenchanter_1.d: While the deeper nature of the Sirens' mysterious song still eludes us, preliminary studies suggest that firing focused discharges of energy at specific frequencies into quasi-space can mitigate some of the Strife Field's effects, at the cost of drastically increasing the upkeep of the ships these mechanisms are mounted on.

giga_tech_eawaf_disenchanter_2.d: More careful attuning of the Disenchanter mechanisms allow for more efficient countering of the Strife Field's nefarious effects.

giga_tech_eawaf_disenchanter_3.d: Breakthroughs in our understand of the Strife Field's enable us to directly emit counter-melodies to the Sirens' songs within the Immaterium itself, which can ward off even the nefarious Inner Field's mind-controlling effects.

giga_tech_eawaf_disenchanter_4.d: Our understanding of the Sirens' song has now progressed to the point where we can comfortably nullify their mind-controlling field at any scale, albeit at a non-negligible energy cost.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_artillery.d: These artilleries fire large crystalline projectiles imbued with excess psionic energy rendering them somewhat unstable and thus very effective against general enemy defenses.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_autocannon.d: These autocannons spray a flurry of razor-sharp thaumaturgic crystals which, while they struggle to puncture thick armor and are generally stopped clean by shields, can absolutely devastate the more fragile hull of energy starships if it happens to be exposed.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_impactor.d: The Crystalline Impactor relies on thaumaturgic crystals imbued with partial sentience in order to produce devastating seeking projectiles at extremely high velocities meant to damage and penetrate armor.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_missile.d: This unorthodox missile design relies on a ball of charged thaumaturgic crystals lobbed through the void of space. Guided by a partial sentience wishing only to see the destruction of its opponents, it can slip through shields and armor alike in order to cause maximum carnage upon its beloathed foes.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_strike_craft.d: Instead of being more conventional assault strike crafts, these high-health fighters exist only to overwhelm, harass and disorient enemy strike craft and PD systems, thus helping our other weapons inflict more damage.

giga_tech_eawaf_sirens_voidbeam.d: This gargantuan beam has the interest effect of psionically-maximizing the entropy of its target, rendering it very efficient against shielding systems.

giga_tech_eawaf_weapons_repeatable.d: The esoteric nature of thaumaturgic weaponry means there is essentially no upper limit on their potential. As long as more energy can be pumped in alongside more crystals to carry that energy, they can continue getting more and more powerful.

tech_wilderness_mineral_purification_1.d: Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.

tech_robomodding_m.d: Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.

tech_robotic_workers.d: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.

tech_space_mining_2.d: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.

tech_robomodding.d: Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.

tech_assembly_pattern.d: Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.

tech_housing_1.d: The ability to alter a planet's weather patterns to suppress destructive weather phenomena will make residential buildings easier to maintain and open up new areas for habitation.

tech_advanced_industrial_storm_protectio.d: By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.

tech_lost_building_methods.d: Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_micro_replicators.d: Microscopic tools that can assist our replication units in creating the more complex circuitry needed for new drones.

tech_mining_2.d: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.

tech_pyroclastic_resonation.d: By harnessing the extreme thermal energy found on molten worlds, our starbases can increase the energy output in a system with exceptional efficiency.

tech_planetary_engineering.d: Advances in material collection and processing allows our Arkships to engage in planetary-scale resource extraction efforts, or even reshape entire biomes as needed.

tech_space_mining_3.d: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.

tech_mineral_purification_2.d: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.

tech_wilderness_mineral_purification_2.d: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.

tech_integrated_cybernetics.d: Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.

tech_droid_workers.d: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.

tech_space_mining_4.d: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.

tech_robomodding_points_1.d: Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.

tech_housing_2.d: With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!

tech_mining_3.d: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.

tech_binary_motivators.d: These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.

tech_self_assembling_components.d: Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.

tech_space_mining_5.d: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

giga_tech_orbital_ring_strategic_resourc.d: Orbital Rings can be used as a platform to build a variety of devices to increase the yield of rare resource extraction and refining facilities. Although this is quite efficient, it is only applicable where there are existing resources to extract.

tech_construction_templates.d: Standardized pre-fab templates massively reduce on-site facility construction times.

tech_identity_copy.d: We will be able to copy the identity and memories of a Synthetic into a new mechanical body. The copies have predictable skill sets but make for stale conversation.

tech_identity_fusion.d: Merging the identities and memories of two or more Synthetics into a mechanical body will create new, somewhat unique individuals.

tech_identity_initialization.d: We will be able to initialize an identity kernel and provide it with a virtual childhood. While expensive, we can simulate the optimal experiences to generate productive personalities.

tech_mega_assembly.d: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new units.

tech_nanite_assemblers.d: Using programmable nanites to assist in the construction of new robotic units will allow for more advanced models that are equipped with an even greater array of subsystems.

tech_robot_assembly_complex.d: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.

giga_tech_crystal_megabore.d: Rare crystals are often formed when extreme pressures meet extreme temperatures within the interior of celestial bodies. It's then up to random chance to bring them up to the surface, where they can be harvested by us. However, this luck factor can be eliminated by boring straight through a world's crust, and directly harvesting the precious crystals from there!

giga_tech_automated_stripmine_2.d: Thanks to advanced orbital construction techniques, as well as new ultrareplicating industrial excavation machines, the prospect of extracting the entirety of a planet's minerals might become a reality.

giga_tech_orbital_ring_supertensiles_min.d: Dedicated processing spaces for Supertensile Materials on our orbital rings have the potential to boost local extraction and processing operations significantly.

tech_synthetic_workers.d: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.

tech_robomodding_points_2.d: Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.

tech_synthetic_leaders.d: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.

tech_arkship_planetary_refinery.d: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_1.d: The first generation of Sentient Metal technology was developed through intensive study of the Enigmatic Pattern transmitters and Primordial Pillars. It is focused on an industrial structure that will replicate Sentient Metal.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_5.d: The fifth generation of Sentient Metal technologies includes a new type of autocannon, and an improved fabrication lab that can produce even more of the material.

tech_fe_affluence_1.d: This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.

tech_fe_forge_1.d: This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.

tech_leviathan_techgenesis.d: Utilizing the received knowledge seized from Leviathans, we now have access to new improvements for our frames.

tech_fe_assembly_1.d: An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.

giga_tech_star_lifter.d: Stars contain incomprehensible amounts of resources. By using specialized gravitylifts and fusion furnaces, those resources can be extracted and converted into usable minerals!

giga_tech_hyperstructural_ass.d: Sometimes, even the largest of citadels doesn't provide enough shipyards to satisfy an empire's production needs. The answer is simple: go bigger. Much bigger. The Hyperstructural Assembly Yard would be an absolutely gargantuan structure built around a star, consisting of an inner stellar-lifting ring and an outer shipyard ring, similar to the Equatorial Shipyard. This humongous construct would provide immense ship-building capabilities, as well as vast amounts of naval capacity.

tech_fe_affluence_2.d: This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.

tech_fe_forge_2.d: The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.

tech_fe_assembly_2.d: A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.

giga_tech_equatorial_shipyard.d: Molten Worlds possess incredible potential when it comes to expanding our shipyards. We can utilize their geothermal activity to power our facilities, and harvest their resources to construct the ships themselves. Setting up a specialized harvesting ring around such a world would certainly prove to be very useful.

tech_ring_world.d: A Ring Segment allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.

giga_tech_ring_world_swap_no_habitables.d:
Planets are very, very large.
To effectively collect materials on such extreme scales, new control systems must be developed for specialized mining drone swarms.

giga_tech_repeatable_hyperstructural_ass.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Hyperstructural Assembly Yards within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_furnace_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Arc Furnaces within our empire's borders.

tech_repeatable_improved_tile_mineral_ou.d: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.

giga_tech_repeatable_crystal_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Crystal Megabores within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_drill_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Automated Stripmines within our empire's borders.

tech_dyson_gun.d:
KILOSTRUCTURE - HYPERWEAPON
Creates a cannon that can do damage to enemy structures, ships, and planets from a long distance.
Allows us to shoot our energy stockpile at targeted systems with potentially devastating effects.

tech_engineering_2.d: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.

tech_exotic_gases.d: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.

tech_wilderness_exotic_gases.d: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.

tech_nanite_transmutation.d: The mass-production of these rare resources require particularly capable nanites.

tech_orbital_arc_furnace.d:
KILOSTRUCTURE - ADVANCED RESOURCE PRODUCTION
Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the Arc Furnace unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.
A device allowing for large systems to be made into productive powerhouses.

tech_wilderness_rare_crystals.d: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.

tech_advanced_metallurgy_1.d: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.

tech_ship_armor_3.d: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

tech_bio_ship_armor_3.d: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

tech_mine_betharian.d: The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.

tech_mine_exotic_gases.d: Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.

tech_supreme_alloy.d: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_armor_hardeners_1.d: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.

tech_asteroidal_carapace.d: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

tech_engineering_3.d: The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.

tech_mandibles_2.d: These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.

tech_alloys_2.d: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.

tech_wilderness_alloys_2.d: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.

tech_luxuries_2.d: These kiosks can replicate any pre-approved object if its pattern has been stored within their memory banks.

tech_ship_armor_4.d: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

tech_bio_ship_armor_4.d: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

giga_tech_engineering_test_site.d: Constructing a testing facility in orbit of a planet can prove to be both difficult and incredibly deadly. However, the potential applications are very promising.

tech_crystal_armor_2.d: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

tech_mandibles_3.d: These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.

tech_advanced_metallurgy_2.d: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.

tech_ship_armor_5.d: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

tech_bio_ship_armor_5.d: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

tech_cosmogenesis_world.d: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.

tech_dragon_armor.d: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.

tech_bio_dragon_armor.d: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_2.d: The second generation of Sentient Metal technology concerns both employing the material to create starship-grade armor, and a new type of flak battery turret that uses the material's networked intelligence to effectively target and neutralize incoming projectiles.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_3.d: The third generation of Sentient Metal technology has allowed further refinement of existing armor designs, and designs for a new type of railgun that makes use of the material to both target and damage enemy vessels.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_4.d: The fourth generation of Sentient Metal technologies concerns both a new type of artillery system utilizing the material, and a ship computer based on the material's networked intelligence.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_6.d: The sixth generation of Sentient Metal technologies is compromised of a new type of spinal-mounted cannon, further revisions to the armor designs, and a power core that taps into the energy source of the Primordial Pillars to provide enormous amounts of energy.

tech_fe_fabricator_1.d: This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.

tech_fe_mine_1.d: This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.

tech_nanite_repair_system_synth_queen.d: Cetana's advanced nanite systems will tirelessly repair and refresh our ships at a rate far beyond our current capabilities.

tech_mine_living_metal.d: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.

tech_sm_armor.d: Sentient metal reconstitutes and replicates when damaged, dynamically adapting to environmental effects. This makes it a perfect substance for armor.

giga_tech_amb_living_metal_infusion.d: The regenerative properties of living metal could theoretically be exploited to improve the quality and output of our molecular foundries.

tech_armor_hardeners_2.d: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

tech_repeatable_improved_armor_output.d: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.

tech_afterburners_1.d: These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.

tech_torpedoes_1.d: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

tech_missiles_2.d: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.

tech_autocannons_1.d: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

tech_bio_autocannons_1.d: Sharper quills, fired at increased rates, deliver devastating volleys to overwhelm shields and shred hulls.

tech_bio_mass_drivers_3.d: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.

tech_missiles_3.d: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.

tech_thrusters_2.d: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

tech_bioship_thrusters_2.d: An array of electrically charged organs accelerate ions to generate thrust.

tech_thrusters_bio_integration.d: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.

tech_bio_autocannons_2.d: Refined biological quills fire with superior velocity to pierce through even hardened defenses.

tech_mass_drivers_4.d: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

tech_thrusters_3.d: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

tech_bioship_thrusters_3.d: Further refinements of the electrical capabilities of the motor organs allow for greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

tech_torpedoes_2.d: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

tech_kinetic_artillery_1.d: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

tech_bio_kinetic_artillery_1.d: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

tech_afterburners_2.d: This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.

tech_flak_batteries_3.d: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

tech_bio_flak_batteries_3.d: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

tech_autocannons_3.d: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

tech_bio_autocannons_3.d: Hyper-dense quills can be fired at a blistering pace eviscerating shields and carving through heavily armored targets with ease.

tech_mass_drivers_5.d: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

tech_bio_mass_drivers_5.d: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

tech_missiles_5.d: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.

tech_thrusters_4.d: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

tech_bioship_thrusters_4.d: Highly advanced fusion chambers grant this ship unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

tech_torpedoes_3.d: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

tech_kinetic_artillery_2.d: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

tech_bio_kinetic_artillery_2.d: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

tech_mass_accelerator_1.d: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.

tech_bio_mass_accelerator_1.d: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.

tech_swarmer_missiles_1.d: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

tech_bio_swarmer_missiles_1.d: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

tech_nanite_autocannon.d: Highly advanced autocannons capable of ejecting shells that explode into a cloud of nanites at the target, overwhelming shields and chewing through hull sections.

tech_bio_nanite_autocannon.d: The pinnacle of quill weaponry is capable of saturating battlefields with relentless and devastating precision-guided projectiles.

tech_nanite_flak_batteries.d: Improving upon previous designs by launching canisters of nanites capable of eating away at strike craft, these flak batteries are the bane of any fighter pilot.

tech_dark_matter_propulsion.d: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.

tech_bioship_thrusters_5.d: Embedded clusters of dark matter within the ship's tissues enable it to "swim" through space, moving in ways that defy conventional physics and our current understanding of propulsion.

tech_qnm_thrusters.d: Research into negative mass has allowed us to expand its usage within our empire. The substance's exotic properties theoretically allow for non-hyperdrive based FTL travel, but the more mundane properties of our ship architecture mean that we have to settle for thrusters that simply go really, really fast.

tech_qnm_jumpdrive.d: The Jump Drive is already an unbelievable invention on its own, but with the unique properties of negative mass, we were able to enhance it even further! By infusing a ship with the substance at the moment of a jump, we can massively reduce the vessel's mass, and consequently, the amount of energy required to translate it across space. This allows us to travel farther and more routinely on the same basic Jump Drive design.

giga_tech_war_moon_artillery.d: Conventional Attack Moon designs employ a highly energetic laser embedded into the moon's crust in order to fight other capital ships. However, replacing the laser with a large mass accelerator firing a relativistic projectile at its target is another viable way of dealing with enemy warships, and is not as energy-hungry as the first option, albeit the damage output is somewhat reduced.

giga_tech_war_moon_sections.d: Developing new ways of arranging the weapons on our Attack Moons will enable them to adapt to almost any situation and take on almost every type of foe.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_kinetic_dama.d: Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_kinetic_fire.d: Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_explosive_da.d: With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_explosive_fi.d: Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.

tech_corvettes.d: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.

tech_destroyers.d: While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.

tech_ordered_retreat.d: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.

tech_starbase_3.d: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

tech_ship_storm_weapons_2.d: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.

tech_temple_of_transportation.d: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.

tech_waystation_2.d: Our Waystations are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.

tech_medium_space_fauna_hull_1.d: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Medium Space Fauna.

tech_defense_platform_hull_1.d: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.

tech_modular_engineering.d: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.

tech_cruisers.d: Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.

tech_destroyer_hull_2.d: The latest generation of destroyer hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

tech_medium_space_fauna_hull_2.d: We have pushed the limits of Medium Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.

tech_habitat_1.d: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.

tech_starbase_4.d: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

tech_strike_craft_3.d: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

tech_waystation_3.d: Advanced coordination protocols bind distant Waystations into a cohesive network. Resources, signals, and supplies move across the Waylines with unmatched precision.

tech_arkship_construction.d: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

tech_cruiser_build_speed.d: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of cruisers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.

tech_large_space_fauna_build_speed.d: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Large Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.

tech_cruiser_hull_1.d: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable cruisers.

tech_large_space_fauna_hull_1.d: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Large Space Fauna.

tech_orbital_ring_tier_1.d: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.

tech_space_defense_station_improvement.d: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

tech_arkship_tier_2.d: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.

tech_military_arkship.d: Military Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.

tech_ehof_phase_01.d: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator and squeezed electromagnetic fields to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. Due to their indeterministic behavior, their destinations are largely beyond our control.

giga_tech_event_squareworld.d: By analyzing the data from the odd Squareworld, we can learn a great deal about eccentric construction techniques and outside-the-box engineering.

tech_battleships.d: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.

tech_cruiser_hull_2.d: The latest generation of cruiser hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

tech_large_space_fauna_hull_2.d: We have pushed the limits of Large Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.

giga_tech_succ.d: The atmospheres of Gas Giants are full of resources such as Exotic Gases. Massive tractor beams, paired with fusion and refining facilities, could allow us to steadily stripmine a Gas Giant's atmosphere, harvesting all of its resources.

tech_habitat_2.d: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.

tech_starbase_5.d: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

tech_strike_craft_skrand.d: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

tech_battleship_build_speed.d: Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.

tech_extra_large_space_fauna_build_speed.d: Establishing new standards for the cloning and nurturing of Huge Space Fauna greatly improves the efficiency of the reproduction pipeline.

tech_battleship_hull_1.d: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.

tech_extra_large_space_fauna_hull_1.d: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Huge Space Fauna.

tech_ehof_phase_02.d: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. The photonic matter and negative pressure enhance the entire process, increasing the Event Horizon Offset Facility's precision and expanding its range of destinations.

tech_habitat_3.d: Years of improvements to our Orbital Habitats have led us to create newer more effective designs.

giga_tech_asteroid_artillery.d: The ever-growing size of modern warships means that starbases will simply not cut it anymore when it comes to defending our territory, but logistical problems prevent a conventional defensive platform from getting too large. However, by embedding a defensive installation into a large asteroid, we can simultaneously solve the problems posed by recoil, as well as those caused by maintenance issue by integrating the structure's internals into the asteroid itself and mining it for resources whenever needed. This would effectively enable the construction of much larger and significantly more powerful defensive bastions.

tech_arkship_tier_3.d: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

tech_ehof_spinal.d: This device, mounted on the spine of an Arkship, utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, squeezed electromagnetic fields, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes.

giga_tech_asteroid_artillery_pen_shots.d: Improved large-scale integration of nanites and self-repairing constructs within Asteroid Artilleries means they can repair themselves much quicker and more efficiently than before.

giga_tech_birch_world_1.d: The Birch World was only a theoretical artificial construct intended for the most expansive of habitations, but it is now a reality. Built around the largest of black holes, these spacious shell worlds are specially made as to be built upon the event horizon of said black holes, at which level the surface gravity is comparable to the gravity of our home world.

tech_btc_1.d:
A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.

When the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.

tech_cosmogenesis_FE_titan.d: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.

tech_cosmogenesis_battlecruiser.d: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.

tech_cosmogenesis_escort.d: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.

tech_battleship_hull_2.d: The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

tech_extra_large_space_fauna_hull_2.d: We have pushed the limits of Huge Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.

tech_ehof_sentient_tier_7.d: The seventh generation of Sentient Metal technologies, developed as a result of our study of the secrets of the Everchanging. It is compromised of the technology for a new type of titan-sized-turret, which makes use of Sentient Metal for aiming at targets, tracking them and damaging them, and an even more advanced type of the Sentient Metal armor.

tech_nanite_repair_system.d: A highly effective hull auto-repair system comprised of billions of microscopic nanomachines was found among the smoking remains of the Scavenger, and has been repurposed for our uses. Whether the Scavenger pilfered this system from an ancient derelict, or was originally constructed with it remains unknown.

tech_juggernaut.d: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.

giga_tech_neutronium_gigaforge.d: Constructing a station capable of massively extracting Neutronium to apply it to our military is quite a technical challenge, but it could prove to be very useful.

tech_titans.d: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.

tech_mega_engineering.d: To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.

giga_tech_nidavellir.d: The pinnacle of alloy technologies. By exploiting the physics-defying nature of neutron stars alongside advanced spacetime manipulation, it becomes possible to utilize a neutron star's properties to facilitate mineral refining processes, making the mass-production of alloys trivial. Those alloys, when mixed with harvested neutronium, could then be transformed into the purest and most powerful weapons ever designed by a sapient species, capable of bending spacetime itself. This would require a colossal ring structure built around a neutron star, employing the most advanced technologies known to the galaxy.

tech_colossus.d: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.

tech_titan_hull_1.d: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.

tech_titanic_space_fauna_hull_1.d: Advances in cloning techniques will allow for the creation of sturdier and more durable Gigantic Space Fauna.

giga_tech_arkship_neutronium_harvester.d: By providing our Arkships with the means to harvest stellar remnants such as Neutron Stars, we can guarantee a reliable source of valuable alloys for aeons to come.

giga_tech_asteroid_artillery_health_upgr.d: Enhancing the survivability of our Asteroid Artilleries is crucial, and thus improving their shield generators will enable them to survive additional punishment.

giga_tech_orbital_arcologies.d: As planets grow and develop, they often start to run out of space for additional districts. By constructing massive ringworlds around a planet's equator, vast amounts of usable space can be created.

giga_tech_planetary_drive_yard.d: Instead of focusing entirely on a system's Starbase in order to assemble our vessels, decentralizing our shipyard facilities by building large orbitally-constructed shipyards around our worlds has the potential to drastically increase the efficiency of our military shipbuilding complex.

giga_tech_war_moon_1.d: The larger a ship, the harder it is to make it move. Developing new and exciting types of mega movement systems could open the door to some incredible projects.

giga_tech_ring_world_swap.d: A Ring Segment allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.

tech_sm_megastructure.d:
MEGASTRUCTURE - STRATEGIC RESOURCE PRODUCTION
The Sentient Metal Forge siphons material from the Everchanging, creating massive quantities of Sentient Metal and Quasi-Negative Mass, and increasing the productivity of our empire's  .

tech_pk_cracker.d: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

tech_pk_nanobots.d: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.

tech_pk_smelter.d: Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.

tech_titan_hull_2.d: The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

tech_titanic_space_fauna_hull_2.d: We have pushed the limits of Gigantic Space Fauna tissue strength to its known maximum.

giga_tech_planetary_drive_yard_defense.d: Our worlds need to be defended even if our main battle fleets are in another corner of our empire. Adapting the Planetary Dockyard into a veritable orbital fortress capable of housing and deploying its own defense fleet will ensure our worlds remain ready to defend against hostile incursions at all times.

giga_tech_planetary_drive_yard_shipyard.d: Additional upgrades made to our decentralized Planetary Dockyards such as expanded infrastructures will further enhance our shipbuilding capabilities in the long run.

giga_tech_war_moon_2.d: In terms of mobile armament, the Titan was thought to be as large as it could get. The idea of moving an entire moon and using it as a weapon sounds impossibly ludicrous. But advances in mega-engineering technologies and energy configuration can make those terrifying moons a reality.

giga_tech_interstellar_habitat.d: The vast void between stars is completely devoid of any life or activity whatsoever. However, by using extremely efficient recycling systems, and advanced engineering, we can turn these once harsh and unexplored territories into our home.

giga_tech_planetary_matter_dumping.d: Dumping tremendous quantities of matter onto a planet's surface is far easier than getting it away from said surface, but it is still a gargantuan undertaking requiring extremely well-oiled logistics and coordination in moving entire planets' worth of mass around.

giga_tech_defense_nexus_capacity_1.d: Improving the infrastructure of our Planetary Defense Nexuses enables us to fit more Strike Corvettes within the megastructure's frame.

giga_tech_defense_nexus_production_1.d: Minute improvements in the assembly process of our Strike Corvettes yield noticeable results in their final assembly rate, ensuring accelerated production.

giga_tech_asteroid_artillery_damage_upgr.d: With the advent of Attack Moons and more capable weaponized planetoids, it is paramount that we ensure our Asteroid Artilleries are able to keep up with the ever-increasing pace of warship development. Integrating several new burgeoning technologies such as higher-dimensional engineering and singularity reactors will ensure the Asteroid Artillery remains a competitive asset in galactic warfare.

giga_tech_war_planet.d: The Attack Moon was thought to be the pinnacle of absurdly huge spacecrafts. But we can go further. If we combine several incredibly advanced technologies, from strong force manipulation to gravity stabilization, it becomes possible to upscale the Attack Moon (~3000km) to a much, much larger body (~15000km). Such an incredibly massive spaceship would be near-indestructible, and could wipe out entire Fallen Empires by itself.

giga_tech_penrose_sphere_3.d: Theoretically, it might be possible to assemble a ringworld powered by a Penrose Sphere. Such a ringworld would be fuelled by electromagnetic radiation fed into the Black Hole's ergosphere, and could provide a safe haven for billions upon billions of years, even after the stars themselves die off.

giga_tech_ringworld_titanic_2.d: One ringworld is surely an amazing feat. But new advances in hypermaterials and logistics might make it possible to construct a second, even larger ringworld around the same star, thus granting even more habitable space! To do so would require rather complicated heating and stabilization systems.

giga_tech_ringworld_upgrade.d:
The main limitation with ringworlds (And, to some extent, other megastructures as well) is the sheer size of the life-support systems used to sustain a stable ecosystem on the surface, as well as the various mechanisms keeping the ringworld in one piece. Such systems include power generation, lifeform cataloguing, gravitational stabilization and so on. While they are currently stored in a dedicated ringworld segment neighboring the habitable segment, sufficiently advanced technologies might make it possible to store most of those systems within the habitable ringworld segment itself, drastically increasing the capacity of our ringworlds.

The Decision should be made on the ringworld segment you wish to upgrade

giga_tech_defense_nexus_damage_1.d: As they lack an FTL Drive, Strike Corvettes can afford to carry much heavier and potent weaponry compared to their regular brethren. Capitalizing on this advantage will ensure they remain competitive with the ever-growing strength of space fleets.

giga_tech_asteroid_artillery_planetcraft.d: Behemoth Planetcrafts have pushed the limits of ship-design and sanity further than ever before. Our Asteroid Artilleries must adapt if they are to remain potent defensive assets in this age of planetary warfare.

giga_tech_maginot_planetcraft_upgrade.d: The newest generation of celestial warships has revealed several possible improvements in Maginot reinforcement, allowing us to make these structures ever more durable in the face of greater threats. Additionally, some weapon and reactor improvements may be retrofitted.

tech_ehof_phase_03.d: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, hardlight constructs, sterile sub-neutrino detectors, and negative mass to manipulate and inflate micro wormholes. The utilization of negative mass induces total stabilization of wormholes, which allows us to keep the inflated micro wormholes open for as long as we see fit. The sterile sub-neutrino detectors further expand the range of destinations our micro wormholes can reach.

tech_ehof_phase_03_nomad.d: Augments the Horizon Drive with hardlight constructs, sterile sub-neutrino detectors, and negative mass. The utilization of negative mass induces total stabilization of wormholes, which allows us to keep the inflated micro wormholes open for as long as we see fit. The sterile sub-neutrino detectors further expand the range of destinations our micro wormholes can reach.

giga_tech_ringworld_behemoth.d: Our overgrowing populous requires miles of urban and rural land that most systems cannot provide. Perhaps it's time for a third ring.

giga_tech_war_system_6.d: At last, we have mastered the technologies necessary to assemble our wonderful masterpiece, the Stellar Systemcraft. All that remains now is to figure out how to manage the logistics involved in supporting such a vast vessel and its population, and this gargantuan construct shall finally set sail through the stars!

giga_tech_defense_nexus_capacity_2.d: Continued development of hangar designs means we can fit significantly more Strike Corvettes within the same volume.

giga_tech_defense_nexus_damage_2.d: With our great improvements regarding hangar optimization, we can afford to make our Strike Corvettes significantly larger and bulkier than before.

tech_ehof_phase_04.d: Utilizing the mysteries of the Everchanging, the E.H.O.F. Ultima is the perfect form of the Event Horizon Offset Facility, capable of traveling to any location of our choosing without limitations and risks. Limitless possibilities await.

tech_ehof_phase_04_nomad.d: Utilizing the mysteries of the Everchanging, the Ultima model is the perfect form of the Horizon Drive, capable of traveling to any location of our choosing without limitations and risks. Limitless possibilities await.

giga_tech_ringworld_gargantuan_1.d: When we enter the realm of habitats that dwarf ringworlds, new types of stabilization and logistical systems need to be developed. Such systems include both practical thrusters to stabilize the structure, as well as software capable of managing the structure's internal activities.

giga_tech_defense_nexus_production_2.d: We can further increase the rate at which our Planetary Defense Nexuses assemble their vessels by enabling said vessels to effectively build themselves.

giga_tech_maginot_systemcraft_upgrade.d: Even as the very stars now move at our command, we must not let our defenses be neglected. Our newest innovations allow several fundamental improvements to Maginot protective measures.

giga_tech_ringworld_gargantuan_2.d: Three ringworlds around the same star is literally bordering madness, but what about a fourth? Such a thing will require stupidly complicated engineering and logistics, but we've gone so far already, so why not go all the way?

giga_tech_alderson_disk.d: An Alderson Disk is a massive, solar-system spanning disk allowing for habitation on its upper surface. Such a construct would be ludicrously expensive, and would require the application of several incredibly advanced technologies to prevent it from collapsing, but could provide untold amounts of industrial capacity and building space.

giga_tech_repeatable_nidavellir_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Nidavellir Hyperforges within our empire's borders.

tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue.d: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new L-Gate Insight into the Disabled L-Gate mystery.

giga_tech_repeatable_succ_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional S.U.C.C. within our empire's borders.

tech_repeatable_improved_military_statio.d: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.
Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.

giga_tech_repeatable_orbital_naval_logis.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Orbital Naval Logistics Office within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_megabase_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Macroengineering Testing Stations within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_gigaforge_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Neutronium Gigaforges within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_defense_nexus_capac.d: New insights into multidimensional engineering enable us to fit even more Strike Corvettes in ever-smaller volumes.

giga_tech_repeatable_orbital_arcologies_.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Orbital Arcologies within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_asteroid_artillery_.d: Further improvements can be made to the design of our Asteroid Artilleries to increase how many times they can be upgraded.

giga_tech_repeatable_stellarhabitat_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Interstellar Habitats within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_ringworld_c.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Ringworlds within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_alderson_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Alderson Disks within our empire's borders.

tech_space_exploration.d: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.

Researched at the start.

tech_automated_exploration.d: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.

tech_basic_science_lab_2.d: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.

tech_wilderness_science_lab_2.d: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.

tech_space_science_1.d: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.

tech_cryostasis_1.d: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

tech_cryostasis_1_wilderness.d: By first incubating our new seedlings in the native soils of new colonies we can speed up the acclimatization process.

tech_space_science_2.d: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.

tech_storm_prediction_1.d: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms.
