“Galactic Storm Management” in force or “Storm Utilization Protocols” in force

tech_auxiliary_fire_control.d: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.

tech_atmospheric_orbital_mechanics.d: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_curator_lab.d: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.

tech_dyson_swarm.d:
KILOSTRUCTURE - BASIC RESOURCE PRODUCTION
An array of interlinked satellites, the Dyson Swarm is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.
A Dyson Swarm is a stepping stone to the raw power of the Dyson Sphere.

tech_consumer_good_refinement_1.d: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.

tech_new_numbers.d: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_orbital_maneuvers.d: Sublight travel can be further optimized by performing advanced calculations that make maximum use of planetary gravity wells.

tech_pd_tracking_2.d: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

tech_bio_pd_tracking_2.d: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

tech_sensors_2.d: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

tech_space_science_3.d: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.

tech_trinary_computing.d: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_decryption_1.d: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

tech_encryption_1.d: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.

tech_detection_array.d: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.

tech_space_science_4.d: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.

tech_decryption_2.d: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

tech_encryption_2.d: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.

tech_assisted_detection.d: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.

tech_combat_computers_bio_integration.d: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.

sw.t: Researched at the start by Beastmasters empires.
Researched at the start.

tech_sensors_bio_integration.d: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.

sw.t: Researched at the start by Beastmasters empires.
Researched at the start.

tech_basic_science_lab_3.d: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!

tech_global_research_initiative.d: A bid for interplanetary resource pools and more flexible research grants.

tech_neuro_quantum_links.d: Advanced neurological implants with connection to quantum computing clusters allow for multi-threaded thoughts.

tech_combat_computers_2.d: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.

tech_sensors_3.d: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

tech_cryostasis_2.d: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

tech_cryostasis_2_wilderness.d: Permanently maintaining specialized seedlings capable of surviving all types of climates massively decreases the time it takes us to create new worlds.

tech_space_science_5.d: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.

tech_storm_prediction_2.d: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms is greatly increased.

“Galactic Storm Management” in force or “Storm Utilization Protocols” in force

tech_science_arkship.d: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

tech_pd_tracking_3.d: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

tech_bio_pd_tracking_3.d: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

tech_decryption_3.d: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

tech_encryption_3.d: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.

tech_combat_computers_autonomous.d: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

tech_consumer_good_refinement_2.d: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.

tech_positronic_implants.d: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.

tech_sapient_ai.d: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

tech_sensors_4.d: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

tech_synchronized_defences.d: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.

tech_arkship_system_scanner.d: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.

tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_1.d: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.

tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_2.d: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.

tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_3.d: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.

tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_4.d: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

tech_cosmogenesis_crisis_5.d:
Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey.

Fallen Empires will try to stop us!

tech_enigmatic_decoder.d: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.

tech_enigmatic_encoder.d: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.

tech_fe_lab_1.d: This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.

tech_prob_c.d: Unimaginably sensitive tachyon sensors, based on and aided by the astonishing capabilities of the sentient metal hive-intellect, determine the target of a micro wormhole before it even emerges in real space. This prediction of wormhole targets increases the precision of Event Horizon Offset Facility travel to a seemingly impossible degree. With this technology, our Event Horizon Offset Facility will be able to form a micro wormhole connecting it to any destination in the galaxy.

tech_quasi_neural_net.d: The discoveries made through the study of the planet-plant brain led to the development of artificial quasi-neural networks. These allow us to perform alternate and unknown methods of data-transmission and data-management in various application areas.

tech_synth_queen_knowledge.d: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.

giga_tech_amb_sentient_metal_molecular_f.d: Processing equipment incorporating the nanoscale computing capacity of sentient metal could lead to dramatic improvements in molecular foundry throughput.

tech_fe_lab_2.d: This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.

tech_lathe_overclocker.d: The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.

tech_lathe_resonator.d: Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.

tech_lathe_validator.d: While the primary purpose of the validator's specialized functions is to help formulate infinity theses, it can also be applied to more general aspects of computing.

tech_qnm_sensors.d: Negative mass allows us to augment our existing sensors by creating much more precise signal filters, resulting in improved scan resolution and fleet detection.

tech_sm_computers.d: The capacities of the Sentient Metal hive mind are tremendous and far beyond even our most powerful information processing networks. By directly connecting it to the systems of our ships and structures, we can implement superordinate orders for it to control our ships and stations like no other ship computer before.

tech_u_r_e_t.d: The unconventional approaches and principles of abstract physics require the construction of new research facilities to develop alternative investigation methods for the comprehension of reality.

tech_science_nexus.d: The research labs and databanks of a Science Nexus generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.

tech_sentry_array.d:
MEGASTRUCTURE - MISCELLANEOUS
Grants Sensor Range over the entire galaxy
The stages of the Sentry Array gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_4.d: The Quasi-Stellar Obliterator is extremely large, and equally gigantic computers will be needed, if we wish to properly maintain the structure, as well as manage the ridiculous amounts of energy employed by the hyperweapon.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

giga_tech_war_moon_specialization.d: New advanced types of Attack Moon computers and crew layouts enable them to more easily adapt to a multitude of roles on the battlefield, from long-range artillery to interceptors and hangars.

tech_non_local_r_i.d: The supercausal phenomena of abstract physics require their own kind of advanced, complex, and powerful research facilities.

tech_cosmogenesis_thesis.d: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.

giga_tech_repeatable_planetary_computer_.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Planetary Computing Complexes within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_array_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Sentry Arrays within our empire's borders.

tech_physics_1.d: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

tech_power_plant_2.d: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.

tech_shields_2.d: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

tech_bio_shields_2.d: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

tech_power_hub_1.d: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.

tech_wilderness_power_hub_1.d: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.

tech_gravity_wells.d: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.

tech_physics_2.d: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

tech_power_plant_3.d: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.

tech_rift_sphere.d: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.

tech_cloaking_1.d: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.

tech_shields_3.d: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

tech_bio_shields_3.d: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

tech_storm_manipulation.d: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.

tech_experimental_subspace_navigation.d: Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.

tech_shield_rechargers_1.d: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.

tech_shield_hardeners_1.d: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.

tech_akx_worm_1.d: The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.

tech_containment_vessel.d: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.

tech_gravity_snare_capacity_2.d: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1

tech_physics_3.d: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

tech_power_plant_4.d: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.

tech_cloaking_2.d: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.

tech_planetary_shield_generator.d: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

tech_nomads_shield_generator.d: Secondary emitter arrays that reinforce the primary shield grid, adding another layer of protection to the hull.

tech_wilderness_shield_generator.d: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

tech_shields_4.d: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

tech_bio_shields_4.d: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

tech_advanced_storm_manipulation.d: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate Cosmic Storms to our own needs.

giga_tech_macro_scale_weather_manipulati.d: Construction of a facility dedicated to creating massive storms within the atmosphere of gas giants could allow us to study the effects far better than any natural storms. The applications of such storm research are very promising.

tech_l_conductor.d: High-energy laser conduction energy distributors allow for interplanetary energy transport and exchange, increasing the efficiency of our empire's power distribution.

tech_gravity_snare_capacity_3.d: Increases the amount of Space Fauna captured by Gravity Snares by 1

tech_giga_power_plant_1.d: High energy pair-annihilation processes are not 100% efficient. The more massive an annihilated particle pair, the more likely the output is less massive particles rather than photons. A new generation of power plants make use of abstract physics to extract the kinetic energy of these decay particles to further increase the efficiency of antimatter-matter annihilation energy generation processes.

tech_negative_pressure.d: Negative pressure is a phenomenon that has been observed before at the quantum level, in the form of the Casimir effect. There, it manifests in form of vacuum fluctuations, but is uncontrollable. Applied abstract physics has lead to the discovery of better-applicable and more efficient ways to generate and control negative pressure.

tech_photonic_m.d: The ability to precisely manipulate electromagnetic wave interference patterns has allowed us to construct stable standing waves capable of interaction with the physical world in ways resembling mundane matter. This "photonic" matter shows great promise in micro-scale manipulation tasks, and will be invaluable in the field of shield harmonics.

tech_cloaking_3.d: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.

tech_shields_5.d: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

tech_bio_shields_5.d: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

tech_mine_dark_matter.d: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy the laws of physics. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

sw.t: Researched at the start only by empires with the Dark Consortium or Shadow Corporation civic.
Researched at the start only by empires with the Dark Consortium or Shadow Corporation civic.

tech_arkship_stellar_igniter.d: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.

giga_tech_fe_megaworkshop_1.d: Huge molecular synthesis arrays work in tandem with replicator bays to process raw minerals into materials for orbital construction.

giga_tech_hrae_mc.d: Black Holes, despite emitting very little energy themselves, are actually energetic powerhouses. The combination of several advanced energy-harvesting methods, adapted to fit around a massive black hole, could let us assemble an extremely efficient machine to completely monopolize all the energy the black hole has to offer.

giga_tech_matrioshka_brain_1.d: In order to fulfill our ever-growing needs for computing power, we must think bigger. By incorporating a dyson sphere-like design into a larger array of computing structures, we could construct a massive system-spanning computer consisting of multiple nested layers feeding off each other's heat.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_1.d: Quasars are incredible energetic objects. If we wish to undertake any sort of engineering projects in their vicinity, it will be necessary to develop advanced shielding to protect our structures from the quasar's gravitational pull and radiation.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

u.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

giga_tech_supermassive_ehof.d: The culmination of E.H.O.F. development coupled with the latest advancements in gigastructural engineering. This monstrous construct, built around the largest of black holes, is theoretically capable of generating a near-infinite amount of microwormholes anywhere within the galaxy, enabling both never-seen-before mobility for our fleets as well as the drastic curbing of most distance-related logistical issues inherent to our empire's size.

giga_tech_tetradimensional_engineering.d: When a structure gets too large and too complex, no amount of support will ever be able to prevent it from collapsing on itself. It therefore becomes necessary to make use of constructs rooted within higher dimensions in order to stabilize these colossal gigastructures. This paves the way for many innovative technologies, such as the ability to fit more matter in a given volume without it collapsing into a black hole, and to be able to defy gravity on unimaginable scales. This also allows for the creation of materials capable of withstanding absolutely ridiculous amounts of stress.

tech_condensed_ews.d: Extremely high energy states lead to the unification of the electromagnetic and weak forces into their initial force, the electroweak force. The secrets of the Everchanging revealed how to manifest physical "Electroweak Quasi-Fields", which open up possibilities for tremendously precise field and spacetime manipulation, even down to the level of quantum foam itself.

tech_fe_silo_1.d: The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.

tech_shield_hardeners_2.d: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.

tech_dark_matter_deflector.d: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.

tech_bio_dark_matter_deflector.d: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.

giga_tech_fe_megaworkshop_2.d: These facilities twist gravity to bind atoms into stable arrangements once thought impossible.

giga_tech_brain_o_star.d: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. In order to assemble a Matrioshka Brain around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Matrioshka Brain, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_2.d: The Hyperquasar at the galactic core is surrounded by a massive and extremely energetic accretion disk. This disk obviously makes it impossible to assemble anything in the quasar's vicinity. However, by altering the gravitational constant near the quasar, we could effectively simulate an increase in the object's mass, which would force the disk to shrink to a smaller size. This would in effect both increase its energetic potential, and allow us to construct a structure much closer to the quasar.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

tech_fe_silo_2.d: By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.

tech_hyperlane_p_t.d: Advances in abstract physics enable the development of ultra-high-capacity hyperlane power transmitters that allow for fast and efficient interstellar energy transmission.

tech_cloaking_dark_matter.d: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.

tech_qnm_shields.d: Negative mass shields actively repel matter and energy striking them rather than simply dissipating the source at its point of impact.

giga_tech_lifter_o_star.d: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. If we are to assemble a Star Lifter around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Star Lifters, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.

tech_giga_power_plant_2.d: Besides the generation of power via active zero-point energy siphoning utilized in reactors, we can use a passive method of siphoning in specialized power plants. This enables us the extraction of zero-point energy in regular power plants, increasing their efficiency beyond 100%.

tech_dyson_sphere.d: A Dyson Sphere fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to Energy Credits.

tech_matter_decompressor.d: The Matter Decompressor lenses a black hole's gravity, forming a drill of gravitational forces to retrieve Minerals from the singularity.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_3.d: One of the supermassive quasar's most prominent feature is the presence of two gigantic jets, consisting of hyperaccelerated jets of ionised matter shooting out from both poles at relativistic speeds. These jets are extremely energetic, and the ability to harvest and redirect their cataclysmic energies would be very useful to power our future hyperweapon.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

tech_hardlight_c_u.d: Dominion over the electromagnetic field will grant us the ability to create pure hardlight constructs, advanced and powerful extensions of photonic matter. These constructs will be able to directly manipulate elementary particles and thus provide even further control of matter and energy.

tech_pk_shielder.d: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).

giga_tech_dyson_o_star.d: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. If we are to assemble a Dyson Sphere around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Dyson Spheres, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.

giga_tech_war_system_4.d: The Systemcraft is going to be subjected to immense stress due to its gigantic size and peculiar configuration. New alloys, employing tetradimensional engineering and strongforce manipulation, are going to be required if we want to keep it in one piece.

giga_tech_orbital_ring_iodizium_hub.d:
Mining Iodizium Crystals is a dangerous process, which could be made safer with the deployment of specialized shield generators on our orbital rings.

Suppression of the crystals' most volatile tendencies and compartmentalization of processing facilities with these shields will reduce losses to catastrophic unplanned disassembly of mining equipment.

tech_field_e_e_t.d: The discovery of non-paradoxical supercausality has led to the development of an immensely efficient and powerful energy distributor. This system utilizes field entanglement energy transregulation to transport tremendous amounts of energy from anywhere to everywhere.

tech_giga_power_plant_3.d: Gravitational waves may be extremely hard to detect, but they contain tremendous amounts of energy. Even small masses release large amounts of gravitational energy in form of these waves. Advanced abstract physics techniques allow us to directly extract energy from gravitational waves, thus making a new generation of reactors and power plants possible.

tech_giga_planetary_shield_generator_2.d: By creating a mass-energy repulsive layer around a planet's atmosphere through the utilization of Negative Mass, this structure shields a planet from even the most intense orbital bombardment. Only long-term bombardment and extremely high energy beams can penetrate the repulsive layer in time.

tech_giga_planetary_shield_generator_2_n.d: By creating a mass-energy repulsive layer around a ship's hull through the utilization of Negative Mass, this technology further reinforces naval shields.

giga_tech_repeatable_dimensional_storage.d: By employing tetradimensional engineering in our storage designs, we can effectively store more resources in the same volume of space.

tech_repeatable_improved_tile_energy_out.d: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.

null_void_beam.d: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

tech_abstract_1.d: Some exotic physical phenomena may not be explainable with quantum-theoretical or string-theoretical approaches alone. tech_bio_cold_fusion_power.d: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

tech_ftl_inhibitor.d: Gravity well projectors can be used to create localized pockets of space where safe entry into hyperspace is impossible. The immense power requirements and the size of the projectors prohibits their use on anything smaller than a space station.

tech_hyper_drive_2.d: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.

tech_disruptors_1.d: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.

tech_bio_disruptors_1.d: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.

tech_lasers_3.d: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

tech_mining_bio_laser.d: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.

tech_plasma_1.d: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.

tech_bio_plasma_1.d: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.

tech_space_cloud_weapon_1.d: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.

tech_mine_volatile_motes.d: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.

tech_nomads_mine_volatile_motes.d: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.

tech_unusual_senses.d: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.

tech_volatile_motes.d: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.

tech_wilderness_volatile_motes.d: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.

tech_hyper_relays.d: Hyper Relays form a chain of structures built outside the gravity well of systems, allowing fast travel from relay to relay rather than requiring transit to established hyperlane entrances.

tech_hyper_drive_bio_integration.d: Traveling across hyperlanes can be hazardous for spaceborne life, but we are able to enhance their capabilities.

sw.t: Researched at the start by Beastmasters empires.
Researched at the start.

giga_tech_event_exotic_lab_data.d: Data from Pouchkinn's Ancient Laboratory provides us with incredible insights on the nature of spacetime.

tech_antimatter_power.d: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

tech_bio_antimatter_power.d: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

tech_hyper_drive_3.d: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.

tech_disruptors_2.d: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

tech_bio_disruptors_2.d: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

tech_lasers_4.d: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

tech_bio_lasers_4.d: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

tech_lgate_activation.d: The L-Gates defy our current understanding of subspace mechanics. This must be remedied before they can be opened for travel.

tech_plasma_2.d: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

tech_bio_plasma_2.d: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

tech_wormhole_stabilization.d: A naturally occurring subspace wormhole is a fickle thing, and its fluctuating energy levels typically make it impossible to travel safely between its linked apertures. There are ways to temporarily stabilize its matrix, however.

tech_quantum_catapult.d: A Quantum Catapult harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.

tech_akx_worm_3.d: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.

tech_abstract_2.d: The extremely efficient approaches of abstract physics are aiding us well in explaining even the universe's most bizarre phenomena. Using these approaches to find novel breakthroughs may give us access to unique and powerful technologies.

tech_reactor_boosters_3.d: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.

tech_energy_torpedoes_1.d: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

tech_bio_energy_torpedoes_1.d: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

tech_gateway_activation.d: The ability to reactivate the derelict Gateway stations that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy has the potential to dramatically shorten travel times.

tech_disruptors_3.d: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

tech_bio_disruptors_3.d: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

tech_lasers_5.d: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

tech_bio_lasers_5.d: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

tech_plasma_3.d: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

tech_bio_plasma_3.d: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

tech_starfire_cannon.d:
Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships.

Unlocks a Colony Decision to construct a Starfire Cannon in orbit.

tech_energy_torpedoes_2.d: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

tech_bio_energy_torpedoes_2.d: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

tech_zero_point_power.d: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

tech_bio_zero_point_power.d: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

tech_arc_emitter_1.d: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

tech_bio_arc_emitter_1.d: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

tech_energy_lance_1.d: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

tech_bio_energy_lance_1.d: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

giga_tech_kugelblitz.d: The ability to generate a Kugelblitz could prove useful, as such objects could be used as efficient singularity generators. Most importantly, controlled Kugelblitzes could be fed matter and energy for later recovery, effectively acting as a Black Hole storage device.

tech_arc_emitter_2.d: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

tech_bio_arc_emitter_2.d: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

tech_energy_lance_2.d: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

tech_bio_energy_lance_2.d: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

giga_tech_lunar_assembly.d: By employing a plethora of methods such as Tetradimensional Engineering and nanites, it becomes possible to quickly and efficiently rearrange large quantities of planetary matter into whatever we want. This effectively enables us to create our own Attack Moons without the need for a naturally-occurring planetoid to build it on, provided we harvest enough planetary matter beforehand.

giga_tech_war_system_1.d: If we wish to weaponize an entire solar system, we must figure out how exactly a star could be moved alongside its planets. Studies into ridiculously-large methods of propulsion will surely yield valuable insight on this problem.

tech_extradimensional_weapon_1.d: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.

tech_fe_singularity_1.d: Capturing the entire energy output from this singularity is an engineering marvel.

tech_abstract_3.d: As abstract physics is very different to other branches of physics, it necessitates customized mathematical formalism to efficiently express it. This "Quoudroplean Formalism" makes use of truly alien mathematical frameworks and theorems that don't fit into the classical universe of mathematics and were thought to be entirely inapplicable and inadequate for reality.

tech_dark_matter_detection.d: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.

giga_tech_terraform_gas.d: The atmospheres of Gas Giants are full of rare resources that are sadly impossible to access due to the planets' tumultuous atmospheres. However, massive orbital gravity modulation arrays above the planet's atmosphere could stabilize the planet's upper atmosphere, potentially allowing colonization by floating cities.

tech_dark_matter_power_core.d: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

tech_bio_dark_matter_power_core.d: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

tech_jump_drive_1.d: A groundbreaking technological marvel, the Jump Drive shreds the local space-time continuum and rearranges it on the quantum level to be identical to that of the target destination - and thus the ship appears to near-instantly "jump" from system to system.

tech_bio_jump_drive_1.d: The revolutionary Jump Organ manipulates the local space-time continuum at the quantum level, restructuring it to match the target destination. This process enables ships to appear to "jump" near-instantaneously between systems.

giga_tech_planet_assembly.d: A grand upscaling of Lunar Macro-Fabrication methods can enable us to fabricate entire Behemoth Planetcrafts instead of mere Attack Moons. It might seem ludicrous, but it might just be possible provided we harvest sufficient planetary matter beforehand.

giga_tech_ndb_1.d: Storing humongous amounts of energy within a stellar-size megastructure could have incredibly useful applications.

giga_tech_war_system_2.d: The core of the Systemcraft, the star itself, is obviously too large to be used practically alongside its companion planets. It is therefore necessary to somewhat compress the star down to a smaller radius, which could be made possible by gigantic gravitopumps similar to those used in the Fusion Suppressor, albeit the resulting star would be much more stable, and able to be exploited more efficiently for power and weaponry.

tech_fe_singularity_2.d: This singularity's power output challenges the laws of physics, yet the containment fields hold with unwavering stability.

tech_arkship_exodus_jump.d: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.

giga_tech_disco_moon.d: A citizen's life can be hard and exhausting. Covering a nearby moon with crystal plates and underground spotlights would create a device capable of projecting magnificent auroras and lights into a planet's sky. Such majestic effects would surely have a positive impact on our people's morale!

giga_tech_penrose_sphere_1.d: Spinning Black Holes have such powerful gravitational fields that they literally drag spacetime along with them while rotating. It is theoretically possible to exploit this process by firing light into a specialized mirror sphere around a Black Hole, which will be amplified by the region of space dragged by the Black Hole.

giga_tech_substellar_compressor.d: Brown Dwarves came just short of starting fusion reactions and becoming stars. With the right technologies and some resources, it might be possible to give them the push needed for them to ignite.

tech_gateway_construction.d: The construction of new Gateway stations enables us to build a fast-travel network that could revolutionize interstellar travel.

tech_qnm_reactors.d: Negative mass reactors utilize polarized flows of the substance and "normal" energy to achieve near-perfect annihilation and commiserately massive power output.

giga_tech_ndb_2.d: Advances in crystalline technologies can lead to a variety of new and incredibly efficient lenses, capable of focusing immense amounts of energy.

giga_tech_war_system_3.d: The Systemcraft's core, a star, generates immense amounts of energy. Incredibly massive and advanced capacitors are required in order to channel this energy into massive, multidimensional capacitors carved within several planets, which will be able to generate enough thrust to move this immense vessel through the void.

tech_negative_e_s.d: Negative energy has been a purely hypothetical, controversial, and extremely abstract topic for a long time... at least until the discovery of the mind-bending negative mass. Abstract physics will allow us to further study this seemingly impossible, yet undeniably real, phenomenon.

tech_ssn_det.d: A unique form of exotic dark matter originating from hyperspace, sterile hyper-neutrinos radiate from the opening of micro wormholes. They possess unique frequencies related to the location that the micro wormholes lead to. By analyzing these frequencies, we can predict the target of an micro wormhole with much higher precision, increasing the accuracy of our Event Horizon Offset Facility.

tech_pk_neutron.d: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.

giga_tech_penrose_sphere_2.d: By using specialized stabilizers and modulators, it becomes possible to drastically increase the amount of controlled radiation a Penrose Sphere can contain, drastically increasing its output.

giga_tech_fusion_suppressor.d: Experimental gravity modulation devices along with special mass injectors can make it possible to alter the cataclysmic energies of a star. Such technologies could allow us to compress and destroy entire stars by strategically disrupting fusion reactions.

giga_tech_ringworld_titanic_1.d: How do we sustain a vast, non-restrained ecosystem without a star to heat it? The answer is artificial light scattering through the dispersal of specific nanocompounds within the habitat's atmosphere, allowing vast heaters to easily warm up the surface of a starless habitat, through exotic heat-transmitting processes.

giga_tech_ndb_3.d: The ability to generate wormholes over large distances could greatly improve our ability to transmit large amounts of energy across the stars.

tech_abstract_4.d: The transportation of information, matter and energy in non-abstract physics is strictly bound to the speed of causality, which in itself is limited and relatively small compared to the size of the universe. Faster-than-causality transmission can only be achieved in circumstances where no information is transmitted or spacetime is bent. However, in abstract physics, the boundaries between fixed rules and unfixed potentialities are themselves fluid and shifting. There are certain ways to work around these rules, change them, or even simply ignore them. As absurd as it may appear.

tech_nm_utilization_1.d: The first generation of devices, processes and methods that utilize negative mass. They are still experimental prototypes and don't utilize the full potential of negative mass, but are powerful nonetheless.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_5.d: Somehow harvesting, storing, and redirecting the sheer energies emitted by a supermassive quasar will require combining several extremely advanced technologies, ranging from hyperdimensional capacitors to supergravitic field modulation.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

giga_tech_war_system_5.d: Our Systemcraft needs the best of weapons. Combining several spacetime disruption technologies could allow for the creation of an energy lance which would carry such immense power drawn from the star itself that no target could hope to withstand it.

giga_tech_ndb_4.d: By using incredibly advanced technologies, it becomes possible to completely focus the output of an entire star into a beam of pure destruction.

giga_tech_quasi_stellar_6.d: The Quasi-Stellar Obliterator is a weapon employing practically every type of technology known to us, in order to make a weapon out of the most energetic body in the entire galaxy. This fearsome construct truly is the pinnacle of hyperscaled weaponry, surpassing even the Nicoll-Dyson Beam and Systemcraft by several orders of magnitude.

a.n: A Weapon to Pierce the Heavens

tech_nm_utilization_2.d: The potential of negative mass is vast. A deeper understanding of this bizarre resource enables the development and creation of even more advanced and powerful negative mass assets.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_energy_damag.d: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_energy_fire_.d: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.

giga_tech_repeatable_kugel_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Kugelblitz Containment Silos within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_disco_moon_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Lunar Speculorefractors within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_penrose_sphere_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Penrose Spheres within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_compressor_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Substellar Compressors within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_suppressor_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Fusion Suppressors within our empire's borders.

tech_arcane_deciphering.d: Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.

tech_archaeostudies.d: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.

sw.t: Researched at the start only by empires with the Flat World origin.
Researched at the start only by empires with the Flat World origin.

tech_archeology_lab_ancrel.d: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

tech_archaeo_lasers.d: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.

tech_archaeo_bio_lasers.d: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.

tech_archaeo_mass_accelerator.d: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.

tech_bio_archaeo_mass_accelerator.d: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.

tech_archaeo_mass_drivers.d: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.

tech_bio_archaeo_mass_drivers.d: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.

tech_archaeo_missiles.d: Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.

tech_archaeo_overcharger.d: Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners. In addition to the production of a stronger force field, this also has the added benefit of outright vaporizing certain incoming projectiles.

tech_archaeo_point_defence.d: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.

tech_bio_archaeo_point_defence.d: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.

tech_archaeo_rampart.d: Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center. Fortifying our Starbase to ensure its survivability in the event of an attack, and maximizing our capacity to network independent orbital defenses would give us more time to dispatch reinforcements.

tech_archaeo_refinery.d: This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.

tech_archaeo_strike_crafts.d: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.

tech_bio_archaeo_strike_crafts.d: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.

tech_archaeoarmor.d: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.

tech_bio_archaeoarmor.d: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.

tech_archaeoshield.d: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.

tech_bio_archaeoshield.d: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.

tech_archaeo_detection_scrambler.d: Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.

tech_archaeo_titan_beam.d: Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.

tech_secrets_baol.d: The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Baol

tech_secrets_cybrex.d: To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could augment our own mining operations, so that we might put their millennia old algorithms to good use.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Cybrex

tech_secrets_irassian.d: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Irassians

tech_secrets_league.d: The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the First League

tech_secrets_vultaum.d: The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Vultaum

tech_secrets_yuht.d: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Yuht

tech_secrets_zroni.d: Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems.

s.n: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

tech_archaeo_pk_devolving_beam.d: A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.

tech_basic_health.d: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.

tech_alien_life_studies.d: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.

tech_gargantuan_evolution.d: Voidspawn eggs have evolved to withstand the harsh conditions of space by absorbing and conserving energy from their nearest star.

tech_genome_mapping.d: Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.

tech_bio_reactor.d: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.

tech_eco_simulation.d: Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.

tech_living_test_subjects.d: The utilization of basic slime-spawned lifeforms as willing test subjects greatly improves research efficiency.

tech_maulers.d: Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.

sw.t: Researched at the start, unless the empire has the Broken Shackles or Payback origin.
Researched at the start, unless the empire has the Broken Shackles or Payback origin.

tech_society_1.d: The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.

tech_space_whale_weapon_1.d: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.

tech_bio_strike_craft_1.d: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

tech_frontier_health.d: The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.

sw.t: Researched at the start only by empires with the Pharma State civic.

tech_food_processing_1.d: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.

tech_wilderness_food_processing_1.d: Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.

tech_mauler_build_speed.d: These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.

tech_mauler_growth_1.d: Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.

tech_weavers.d: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.

sw.t: Researched at the start, unless the empire has the Broken Shackles or Payback origin.
Researched at the start, unless the empire has the Broken Shackles or Payback origin.

tech_mauler_growth_2.d: These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_1.d: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_1.d: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_1.d: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_1.d: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_1.d: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_1.d: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.

tech_weaver_build_speed.d: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.

tech_amoeba_strike_craft_1.d: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.

Researched at the start.

tech_enhanced_cryosleep_sedatives.d: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.

tech_cloning.d: Breakthroughs in enucleation and artificial womb technology allows for the mass-production of individuals based on a common genetic template.

sw.t: Researched at the start only by empires with the Clone Army origin.
Researched at the start only by empires with the Clone Army origin.

tech_epigenetic_triggers.d: Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.

tech_bio_reactor_2.d: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.

tech_gene_crops.d: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.

tech_society_2.d: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.

tech_bio_strike_craft_2.d: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

tech_subdermal_stimulation.d: Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"

sw.t: Researched at the start only by empires with the Pharma State civic.
Researched at the start only by empires with the Pharma State civic.

tech_vitality_boosters.d: Where the body fails, science intervenes.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_2.d: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_2.d: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_2.d: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_2.d: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_2.d: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_2.d: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.

tech_weaver_growth_1.d: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.

tech_gene_banks.d: Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.

tech_alien_cloning.d: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.
