tech_frontier_hospital.d: As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.

tech_weaver_growth_2.d: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.

tech_controlled_mutations.d: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.

tech_improved_incubators.d: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.

tech_gene_tailoring.d: Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.

tech_food_processing_2.d: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.

tech_wilderness_food_processing_2.d: New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.

tech_metabolic_gases.d: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.

tech_nano_vitality_crops.d: Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.

tech_regenerative_hull_tissue.d: A genetically altered version of silicon-based bacteria could potentially be manipulated to regenerate non-organic materials.

sw.t: Researched at the start by Beastmasters empires.
Researched at the start.

tech_society_3.d: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.

tech_bio_strike_craft_3.d: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

tech_universal_marcophage.d: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.

tech_selected_lineages.d: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.

tech_voidworm_immunity.d: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.

tech_harbingers.d: Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_3.d: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_3.d: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_3.d: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_3.d: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_3.d: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_3.d: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.

tech_gene_expressions.d: Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.

tech_glandular_acclimation.d: Through glandular biological tailoring we can change the environmental tolerance of a species to suit our needs.

giga_tech_orbital_artificial_eco.d: Creating a fully working complex ecosystem in orbit of a planet is quite a challenge, but such a technology permits the construction of large ecosystems orbiting a planet for research purposes.

giga_tech_planetary_seeder_nexus.d: Barren worlds, both hot and cold, often feature the basic building blocks of life, merely not in the proper arrangement. However, with the discovery of Cutholoids and Amoebas thriving in the depths of space, there now lies the possibility of creating bespoke artificial 'lifeforms' which, once deposited on lifeless worlds, will be able to accumulate and rearrange these building blocks into various substances suitable for harvest and consumption. As all these would do is shuffle and rearrange scattered molecules into various edible compounds, these would have to be regularly replenished and would not constitute a proper 'biosphere', but could provide a useful supply of materials to our nutrition industries.

tech_harbinger_build_speed.d: These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.

tech_harbinger_growth_1.d: Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.

tech_harbinger_growth_2.d: Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.

giga_tech_event_pouchkinn_lifespan.d: Analyzing the recovered bioimplants from the lone scientist's body will be a great boon to our longevity research.

tech_biomechanics.d: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.

tech_gene_seed_purification.d: Nucleotide purification techniques allow for the isolation and refinement of particularly desirable genetic traits.

tech_controlled_mutations_2.d: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.

tech_morphogenetic_field_mastery.d: From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.

tech_neuroregeneration.d: When tailored to a species' genome, this form of tissue engineering has intensive neuroregenerative properties, significantly increasing the development of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.

tech_nutrient_replication.d: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.

tech_bio_strike_craft_skrand.d: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

tech_capacity_boosters.d: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.

tech_stingers.d: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_4.d: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_4.d: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_4.d: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_4.d: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_4.d: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_4.d: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.

tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity.d: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.

tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid.d: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.

tech_unique_mutation_restorative_enzymes.d: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.

tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba.d: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.

tech_unique_mutation_starborne_biology.d: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.

tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki.d: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.

tech_unique_mutation_voidworm.d: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.

tech_stinger_build_speed.d: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.

tech_stinger_growth_1.d: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.

tech_stinger_growth_2.d: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.

tech_growth_chamber_1.d: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.

tech_growth_chamber_2.d: The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.

giga_tech_the_vat.d: The advent of a new age of genetic engineering has paved the way for even greater and more ambitious projects. While previously restricted to planets, humongous orbital cloning facilities would enable us to rapidly bioengineer and grow veritable armadas of spaceborne creatures to bolster our navy even further.

tech_cosmogenesis_harbinger.d: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.

tech_cosmogenesis_mauler.d: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.

tech_cosmogenesis_stinger.d: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.

tech_cosmogenesis_weaver.d: Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.

tech_fe_clinic_1.d: Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.

tech_fe_nourishment_1.d: Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.

tech_scourge_missile_1.d: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.

tech_swarm_strike_craft_1.d: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.

tech_biogenesis_juggernaut.d: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.

tech_biogenesis_titans.d: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_5.d: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_5.d: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_5.d: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_5.d: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_5.d: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_5.d: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.

tech_fe_clinic_2.d: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.

tech_fe_nourishment_2.d: Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.

tech_lathe_life_support.d: Dedicated facilities organize the maintenance of the Lathe's critical components, allowing us to support more chips and a healthier network environment.

tech_lathe_preserver.d: The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.

tech_sm_auto_repair.d: By constructing the hulls of our ships out of material which contain traces of sentient metal and material reservoirs, our ships can self-repair with extreme efficiency.

tech_biogenesis_colossus.d: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_evasion_6.d: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.

tech_weaver_bio_anti_fire_rate_6.d: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.

tech_weaver_bio_confuser_6.d: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.

tech_weaver_bio_evasion_6.d: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.

tech_weaver_bio_fire_rate_6.d: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.

tech_weaver_bio_healing_6.d: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.

giga_tech_yggdrasil_orchid.d: A Gas Giant hosting a large vegetal organism in its upper atmosphere could be a valuable asset to our food production. Through advanced gene-modding and climate manipulations technologies, such a project could be doable.

giga_tech_ring_world_swap_no_habitables_.d: A persistent enough root can pierce the hardest of bedrock.

giga_tech_repeatable_the_vat_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional The Vats within our empire's borders.

tech_repeatable_improved_tile_food_outpu.d: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.

tech_repeatable_improved_leader_life_spa.d: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.

giga_tech_repeatable_orbital_artificial_.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Orbital Artificial Ecosystems within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_planetary_seeder_ne.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Planetary Seeder Nexuses within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_orchid_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Yggdrasil Orchids within our empire's borders.

tech_doctrine_fleet_size_1.d: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

tech_doctrine_navy_size_1.d: As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.

tech_ground_defense_planning.d: There are many alien empires who would gladly seize our worlds for themselves. We must be prepared for them, should the worst come to pass.

tech_adaptive_combat_algorithms.d: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.

tech_doctrine_fleet_size_2.d: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

tech_doctrine_navy_size_2.d: A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.

tech_interstellar_fleet_traditions.d: A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.

tech_global_defense_grid.d: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.

tech_wilderness_defense_grid.d: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.

tech_predatory_tactics.d: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_interstellar_campaigns.d: A well-oiled war machine is the key to exerting influence on a galactic scale. Backed by the might of our military, we can lay claim to almost anything we want.

tech_centralized_command.d: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.

tech_doctrine_fleet_size_3.d: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

tech_doctrine_navy_size_3.d: Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.

tech_refit_standards.d: Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.

tech_refit_standards_beastmasters.d: Optimizing the process for cloning Space Fauna can lead to massive efficiency gains.

tech_deep_space_citadel.d:
KILOSTRUCTURE - DEFENSIVE
A ​Deep Space Citadel is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.
This logistical and resource hub serves as a base for the construction of a Deep Space Citadel.

tech_combat_training.d: A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.

tech_command_matrix.d: Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.

tech_doctrine_fleet_size_4.d: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

tech_doctrine_navy_size_4.d: By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.

tech_galactic_campaigns.d: Further improvements to administration grant an extended power projection across the stars, and the military clout needed to enforce our demands.

giga_tech_orbital_naval_logistics.d: As our empire's navy grows, so does its needs. One solution to the navy's ever-growing needs is to construct massive Orbital Naval Logistics Offices, housing vast arrays of military equipment to support our fleets.

tech_doctrine_fleet_size_5.d: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

tech_fe_fortress_1.d: This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.

tech_existential_campaigns.d: When survival itself is at stake, the very concept of war loses its meaning. These campaigns are waged not for dominion, but to secure the continued existence of our civilization.

tech_scourge_deployment.d: The Scarlet Scourge is an advanced synthetic toxin that could either be used as a terraforming agent, as originally intended, or as a planet-enveloping chemical weapon capable of destroying all life. Its use is up to us.

tech_fe_fortress_2.d: This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.

tech_lathe_cogitator.d: Calculating hyperspatial supply chains is complex. Rerouting some processing power to the task will help even the largest fleet to delve deeper into enemy territory.

giga_tech_maginot_world.d:
To defend our empire we must construct the ultimate defensive strongpoint, and transform an entire planet into a massive fortress complex - the Maginot World.

This world shall be equipped with orbital defenses, planetary cannons, countless bunkers, deep underground command complexes, and continent-sized shield generators. In addition, a Dead Hand system will be developed to deter enemy Colossus-class warships.

The planetary building is necessary to begin Maginot World construction, but the building can also be built in other locations not suitable for full development.

giga_tech_maginot_world_wilderness_swap.d:
To defend our habitats we must evolve the ultimate defensive strongpoint, and transform an entire planet into a massive fortress biome - the Maginot World.

This world shall be equipped with orbital defenses, planetary cannons, countless bunkers, deep underground command-hormone organs, and continent-sized shield generators. In addition, a Dead Hand organ will be developed to deter enemy Colossus-class warships.

The planetary building is necessary to begin Maginot World construction, but the building can also be built in other locations not suitable for full development.

tech_mega_shipyard.d: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.

tech_strategic_coordination.d: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.

giga_tech_maginot_firepower_1.d: With practical developments complete, we can now focus on further pushing the envelope with regards to various optimizations for the Maginot World systems. In particular, ever greater firepower.

giga_tech_repeatable_systemcraft_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Stellar Systemcraft within our empire's borders.

tech_repeatable_command_limit.d: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.

tech_repeatable_improved_army_damage.d: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.

tech_repeatable_improved_army_health.d: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.

tech_repeatable_naval_cap.d: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.

tech_repeatable_weapon_type_strike_craft.d: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.
By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.

giga_tech_repeatable_maginot_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Maginot Worlds within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_warmoon_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Attack Moons within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_warplanet_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Behemoth Planetcrafts within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_shipyard_ca.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Mega Shipyards within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_strategic_c.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Strategic Coordination Centers within our empire's borders.

tech_wilderness_terraform.d: To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.

Researched at the start.

tech_colonization_1.d: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.

sw.t: Researched at the start.
Researched at the start.

tech_colonization_1_wilderness.d: We turn our focus to calculating the resources and materials required to awaken new worlds, thereby readying our pioneer symbionts for their arduous voyages across the stars.

sw.t: Researched at the start.
Researched at the start.

tech_deep_sinkhole.d: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.

tech_dense_jungle.d: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.

tech_massive_glacier.d: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.

tech_noxious_swamp.d: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.

tech_quicksand_basin.d: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.

tech_toxic_kelp.d: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.

tech_alien_topography.d: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_cryovault.d: By harnessing the subthermal dynamics found in the environments of frozen worlds, we can create more hospitable living conditions in colder climates.

tech_galactic_ambitions.d: Our future lies in the sea of stars.

tech_colonial_centralization.d: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.

tech_wilderness_colonial_centralization.d: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.

tech_colonization_2.d: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.

tech_dangerous_wildlife.d: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.

tech_mountain_range.d: With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.

tech_volcanic_forge.d: When deployed, this facility slowly transforms a planet into a volcanic paradise, surfacing useful resources along the way. Thermoforgers can accelerate the transformation.

tech_volcano.d: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.

tech_planetary_infrastructure_1.d: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.

tech_colonization_3.d: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.

tech_terrestrial_sculpting.d: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.

tech_volcanic_terraforming.d: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.

tech_georadiation_terraforming.d: By exposing the biosphere of a planet to molecular radiation decay, we promote the growth of certain resources while turning the world into a toxic wasteland.

tech_colonization_4.d: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.

tech_ecological_adaptation.d: By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.

tech_tomb_world_adaption.d: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.

giga_tech_asteroid_manufactory.d: As leftovers from the formation of most solar systems, asteroids are rich in easily-accessible raw resources. Large constructs built around them equipped with specialized harvesters could be employed to steadily collect these resources, and ship them to planetside factories for processing or consumption.

tech_civilian_arkship.d: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

tech_manifest_destiny.d: We must have to courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.

tech_planetary_infrastructure_2.d: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.

tech_colonization_5.d: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.

tech_climate_restoration.d: By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.

giga_tech_terraform_barren.d: Re-activating a planet's magnetic field and seeding a breathable atmosphere are two very difficult tasks. However, increasingly advanced terraforming techniques can bring these feats closer to reality.

giga_tech_terraform_toxic.d: Huge orbital chemical conversion plants make it theoretically possible to entirely clear a toxic world's atmosphere of toxic components, making it habitable to most species.

giga_tech_planetary_computer.d: The solution to ever-expanding needs for computing power: an entire planet transformed into a computer! Using specialized terraforming techniques, this seemingly silly project can become a reality.

giga_tech_planetary_computer_wilderness_.d: One brain alone is weak, but many brains together are strong. The Wilderness has always been an emergent property of its many members, but it is time to take the next step: interconnecting floral electrochemical systems across the planetary crust could effectively transform an entire celestial body into one wetware computer.

giga_tech_terraform_molten.d: Molten Worlds are amongst the harshest of rocky planets. Their surface is torn asunder by tidal forces and geological activity. However, by utilizing colossal orbital cooling beams as well as megastructural laser drills to alter their tectonic makeup, it might become possible to cool down and stabilize the surface of such a world, potentially rendering it habitable.

giga_tech_terraform_shattered.d: Shattered and Broken Worlds are the harshest of rocky planets. Their surface having been torn asunder by an unknown force, whether it be a superweapon or a superorganism. However, by utilizing colossal gravitational engines it might become possible to collect and unify the fragments of such a world, potentially rendering it terraformable.

tech_repeatable_improved_core_system_cap.d: Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.

tech_repeatable_improved_starbase_capaci.d: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.

giga_tech_repeatable_asteroid_manufactor.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Asteroid Industrial Sites within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_terraform_barren_ca.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Dynamic Core Ignitors within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_terraform_toxic_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Atmospheric Purifiers within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_terraform_gasgiant_.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Macroatmospheric Stabilizers within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_geothermal_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Geothermal Stabilizers within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_glue_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional G.L.U.E. within our empire's borders.

tech_psionic_suppression.d: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.

tech_materiality_engine.d: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.

tech_psionic_aura.d: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.

tech_psionic_theory.d: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.

tech_aura_resonation.d: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Psionic Projector, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.

tech_psionic_barrier.d: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.

tech_bio_psionic_barrier.d: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.

tech_mine_zro.d: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted individuals, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.

tech_telepathy.d: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.

tech_aura_intensification.d: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.

giga_tech_shroud_conduit.d: After much meditation and study, our telepaths believe that it may be possible to open stable tunnels into the realm known as the Shroud. Though sub-atomic in scale, controlled use of these tunnels would allow our psionic population to benefit from energies otherwise restricted to dangerous and expensive rituals.

tech_precognition_interface.d: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.

tech_thought_enforcement.d: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.

tech_thought_enforcement_gestalt.d: With additional study, our telepath drones could identify deviant impulses before they emerge as conscious thought, and correct these aberrations as necessary.

giga_tech_psychic_beacon.d: The efforts of our astropaths could, theoretically, be amplified several times more through the use of a specialized navigational megastructure.

tech_psionic_bombers.d: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

tech_bio_psionic_bombers.d: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

tech_psionic_disruptor.d: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

tech_bio_psionic_disruptor.d: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

tech_psionic_lightning.d: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

tech_bio_psionic_lightning.d: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

tech_covenant_composer.d: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.

tech_covenant_cradle.d: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.

tech_covenant_whisperers.d: We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.

tech_psionic_shield.d: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.

tech_bio_psionic_shield.d: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.

tech_psi_jump_drive_1.d: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.

tech_bio_psi_jump_drive_1.d: The Psi Jump Organ acts as a focus point for the the psionic potential of the ship and crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.

tech_zro_launcher.d: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

tech_bio_zro_launcher.d: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.

tech_cloaking_psi.d: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.

giga_tech_psychic_hypersiphon.d: The Shroud is a strange realm. By combining new containment technologies with immense telepathic power, it might become possible to directly link our reality with that of the Shroud on a macroscopic scale. Doing so might improve our Shroud Conduits greatly, bringing our prosperity to new heights. Potential for bleed-through of unwanted energies is theorised to be unavoidable, but minimal at worst.

tech_pk_godray.d: An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.

giga_tech_repeatable_siphon_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Psychic Hypersiphons within our empire's borders.

tech_hive_node.d: Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.

tech_hyper_entertainment_forum.d: These massive entertainment complexes is where dreams come true. Shopping malls, restaurants, amusement parks, virtual arcades, and more. You dream it - we are it!

tech_neural_implants.d: Cognition is little but the processing of sensory input. It can be altered.

tech_space_trading.d: Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.

tech_xeno_linguistics.d: Given recent encounters with intelligent races, it is essential that we improve our xeno-linguistic capabilities.

tech_cultural_heritage.d: An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.

tech_artificial_moral_codes.d: It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.

tech_compact_living.d: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_galactic_archivism.d: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.

tech_hive_cluster.d: By clustering networks of macroscopic synaptic nodes, maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area can be attained.

tech_holographic_rituals.d: Seeing is believing, and belief begets reality.

tech_capital_productivity_1.d: As our colonies become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.

tech_colonial_bureaucracy.d: Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.

tech_effective_bureaucracy.d: Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.

tech_heritage_site.d: Physical reminders of how far we have come both instill a reverence for past achievements and bolster ambitions for the future.

tech_satisfying_insults.d: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_slave_colonies.d: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.

tech_unity_of_purpose.d: The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.

tech_wilderness_cluster.d: We can accelerate the fluency of global, collective thought by investing it in gatherings of symbionts whose sole purpose in life is to facilitate that same will.

tech_xeno_aesthetics.d: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.

s.n: Conflict! What is it Good For?

tech_penal_colonies.d: Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.

tech_autonomous_agents.d: Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.

tech_federation_code.d: A Federation must be more than goodwill and shared ambition. This code provides the groundwork for a unified interstellar order, ensuring cooperation and stability among its members.

tech_node_culling_1.d: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.

tech_node_reformatting_1.d: Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.

tech_resort_colonies.d: With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.

tech_xeno_diplomacy.d: Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.

tech_akx_worm_2.d: A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.

tech_executive_retreat.d: A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local culture in a high security environment.

tech_housing_agrarian_idyll.d: Through the establishment of weather-controlled rural communes, we can support a larger population without disrupting our agrarian way of life.

tech_paradise_dome.d: With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.

tech_autocurating_vault.d: Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.

tech_capital_productivity_2.d: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.

tech_collective_self.d: Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.

tech_consecration_fields.d: Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.

tech_embodied_dynamism.d: Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.

tech_galactic_administration.d: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.

tech_wilderness_galactic_administration.d: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.

tech_galactic_bureaucracy.d: Multiple administrative strata efficiently surface only the most vital information to the upper levels of government.

tech_global_production_strategy.d: Planets are big and production sites are often separated by vast distances. A coherent strategy for making certain that everyone is pulling in the same direction is often needed.

tech_hive_confluence.d: The will of the Hive will be further strengthened and coordinated with the expansion and development of a massive nervous center of meganeurons.

tech_hypercomms_forum.d: Not all research into faster-than-light communication channels produces useful results, but some outcomes may find new purpose in bringing our people together.

tech_node_culling_2.d: Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.

tech_node_reformatting_2.d: Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.

tech_prescient_data_modeling.d: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.

s.n: Caravan Fleet: The Numistic Order: Last Call

tech_interstellar_economics.d: As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.

tech_synthetic_thought_patterns.d: Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.

tech_wilderness_confluence.d: Our mutualistic will shall be strengthened by vast gatherings of deeply empathic symbionts, so in-tune with their surroundings as to concentrate and re-broadcast our collective thought.

tech_xeno_tourism_agency.d: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.

tech_xeno_relations.d: The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.

tech_ascension_theory.d: Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability. By identifying the core, recurring premises of these leaps, we may be able to effectively short-circuit the cycle for our own benefit.

tech_capital_productivity_3.d: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.

tech_node_culling_3.d: Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.

tech_node_reformatting_3.d: Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.

tech_galactic_markets.d: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.

tech_tracking_implants.d: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.

tech_transcendent_faith.d: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.

tech_fe_administration_1.d: Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.

tech_fe_dome_1.d: This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.

tech_fe_entertainment_1.d: These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.

tech_fe_market_1.d: Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.

tech_fe_security_1.d: This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.

tech_fe_administration_2.d: Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.

tech_fe_dome_2.d: Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.

tech_fe_entertainment_2.d: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.

tech_fe_market_2.d: Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.

tech_fe_security_2.d: The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.

giga_tech_ringworld_buildings.d:
Now that we have built truly colossal livable spaces, what if we just... built bigger buildings on them?

It's not that simple of course, but the goal is an attainable one.

tech_interstellar_assembly.d: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.

tech_mega_art.d: An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_interstella.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Interstellar Assemblies within our empire's borders.

giga_tech_repeatable_vanilla_art_cap.d: Advanced construction and maintenance protocols to allow construction and management of additional Mega Art Installations within our empire's borders.
